summaries.path: ATTACK / SPECIAL → BLOOD → channels, Winged Form, Impalement
summaries.observation: Her resource funds both sustained offense and defensive uptime. Winged Form shifts the cost to upkeep.
The base loop is narrow. Talents add new generators, spenders, and rewards around it.
